name: aniwebscale-extension
description: AniWebScale provides real-time anime video enhancement powered by Anime4K and additional upscalers.

scripts.generate:presets: npm run generate:anime4k-vendor && node scripts/generate-preset-graph.mjs && npm run generate:glsl-models && npm run generate:model-shards
scripts.check:presets: node scripts/prune-anime4k-webgpu.mjs --check && node scripts/generate-preset-graph.mjs --check && python scripts/generate-external-glsl-models.py --check && node scripts/generate-model-shards.mjs --check
scripts.build:chrome: npm run generate:presets && cross-env TARGET_BROWSER=chrome webpack --mode production
scripts.build:firefox: npm run generate:presets && cross-env TARGET_BROWSER=firefox webpack --mode production
scripts.build:all: npm run build:chrome && npm run build:firefox
scripts.build:release:chrome: npm run check:identities && npm run build:chrome
scripts.build:release:firefox: npm run check:identities && npm run build:firefox && npm run lint:store:firefox
scripts.build:release:all: npm run build:release:chrome && npm run build:release:firefox
scripts.install:native: npm run build:native && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File native/scripts/install-native-host.ps1 -BinaryDirectory native/build/bin/Release
scripts.test:e2e:chrome: cross-env ANIME4K_E2E=1 npm run build:chrome && cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=.tmp/ms-playwright playwright test -c tests/e2e/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:firefox: cross-env ANIME4K_E2E=1 npm run build:firefox && cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=.tmp/ms-playwright node tests/e2e/run-firefox.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e:chrome && npm run test:e2e:firefox
scripts.dev:chrome: npm run generate:presets && cross-env TARGET_BROWSER=chrome webpack --mode development
scripts.dev:firefox: npm run generate:presets && cross-env TARGET_BROWSER=firefox webpack --mode development
scripts.watch:chrome: npm run generate:presets && cross-env TARGET_BROWSER=chrome webpack --mode development --watch
scripts.watch:firefox: npm run generate:presets && cross-env TARGET_BROWSER=firefox webpack --mode development --watch
